lines.text: While Israel stayed in Shittim, the men joined Moab's daughters in sacrifices and worshiped Baal of Peor, and the LORD's anger burned.
The LORD told Moses to execute the leaders, so Moses told the priests of Israel to kill the men who worshiped Baal.
Phinehas took a spear and drove it through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman, and the plague halted after 14,000 had died.
The LORD said Phinehas was zealous for Him and granted him a covenant of peace and permanent priesthood.
The slain man was Zimri, the slain woman was Cozbi, and the LORD told Moses to attack the Midianites.
